purpose: Safe, consistent image and video sourcing for source-first American city-history videos.
default_rule: Use only sources in preferred_sources or item-level rights-cleared local archive sources. Every final media asset needs a rights-ledger row before owner review.

source_roles.historical_evidence: Can support a historical claim only when the item-level source and rights basis are logged.
source_roles.modern_context: Can support pacing, atmosphere, present-day comparison, generic human action, or texture, but cannot carry a historical claim by itself. A generic street, crowd, traffic, factory, or foot-traffic clip must be labeled context_only and must not imply that it depicts the named city, neighborhood, people, date, or event.
source_roles.original_graphic: Can explain systems, maps, routes, timelines, source boards, and then/now layouts.
source_roles.ai_reconstruction: Can illustrate a concept only when clearly treated as a graphic or reconstruction, never archival proof.
source_roles.original_audio: Can be used for voiceover, music, or sound effects only when the creator/tool and commercial rights basis are logged.
source_roles.original_video: Can be used for Pattern Lab renders, proof clips, Shorts, and assemblies only when derived source assets are logged.
source_roles.original_asset: Can be used for locally created Pattern Lab assets that do not fit a narrower source role.
source_roles.ai_thumbnail_support: Can support thumbnail composition as texture, redacted-paper prop, generic map glow, cutout/mask, background extension, or labeled reconstruction only. It cannot be the city hero or source proof when rights-safe real media exists.

blocked_uses: AI-generated historical photos presented as archival evidence
synthetic visuals used as source proof
synthetic_disclosure_policy.thumbnail_support_rule: AI support assets may be used in thumbnails only as non-evidence support elements. Public-facing thumbnails must not imply AI output is archival proof.
synthetic_disclosure_policy.internet_reference_rule: If an internet image cannot be licensed, do not copy, trace, or make a near-duplicate through AI. Use it only to write generic art direction, then generate a materially new support element.

visual_density_requirements.narration_alignment_rule: Every visual beat should match the nearby narration using source title, filename, source role, or keyword relevance. If the pack cannot match the narration, source more rights-safe media before assembly.
visual_density_requirements.generic_context_rule: Generic rights-cleared footage or stills may illustrate a generic action or human consequence named in the narration, such as foot traffic, commuting, crowd movement, factory work, relocation, or street life. It must be logged as modern_context/context_only, must semantically match the action and emotional function, and must never be presented as evidence that the action occurred in the named city, neighborhood, date, or event.
visual_density_requirements.source_shortfall_rule: If the source pack is short, OpenClaw must search approved sources for more rights-safe photos/video instead of filling the edit with generated graphics.
visual_density_requirements.generated_graphics_rule: Generated graphics are support only when they are overlaid on real source media or photo-backed composites. Do not use full-screen non-picture slides.

generic_context_asset_requirements.reuse_rule: A generic asset may be reused across city episodes only after its exact local hash and item-level rights receipt pass review. It remains context only and may never be relabeled as evidence for a named city or event.
generic_context_asset_requirements.presentation_rule: Use a subtle Illustrative footage label whenever a generic clip could reasonably be mistaken for the named city, neighborhood, date, or historical event.

historical_images.name: Library of Congress
historical_images.rule: Use public-domain, no-known-restrictions, or item-level rights-clear records only.

historical_images.name: National Archives
historical_images.rule: Item-level rights check required; not every holding is automatically public domain.

historical_images.name: Wikimedia Commons
historical_images.rule: Use only licenses compatible with YouTube/commercial use; preserve attribution and share-alike requirements.

historical_images.name: Local libraries and archives
historical_images.rule: Use only when reuse terms are explicit or written permission is obtained.

historical_images.name: Openverse
historical_images.rule: Use only item-level commercial/modification-compatible licenses; preserve original landing URL, creator, and license URL.

historical_images.name: Flickr Commons
historical_images.rule: Use only no-known-copyright-restrictions or compatible item-level licenses; log collection/source page and creator.

historical_images.name: Smithsonian Open Access
historical_images.rule: Use only items explicitly marked CC0; preserve item URL and credit even when attribution is not required.

historical_images.name: Digital Public Library of America
historical_images.rule: Promote only exact items with an Unlimited Re-Use rights category or another independently compatible item statement.

historical_images.name: OpenStreetMap static map service
historical_images.rule: Use as source-grounded map support with OpenStreetMap attribution; owner review required before public use.

historical_images.name: Detroit and other local institutional collections
use_for: local film and oral history leads
historical_images.rule: Burton, Reuther/Wayne State, Bentley, Detroit Historical, and comparable collections are discovery/permission leads unless the exact item provides compatible reuse terms or written permission is logged.

modern_stock_photos.name: Pexels
modern_stock_photos.rule: No historical claim without independent source proof; avoid trademark/personality-risk use.

modern_stock_photos.name: Pixabay
modern_stock_photos.rule: Avoid trademark, logo, recognizable-person, and sensitive-use risks.

modern_stock_photos.name: Unsplash
modern_stock_photos.rule: Do not use as historical proof; avoid implying endorsement.

modern_stock_video.name: Pexels
modern_stock_video.rule: Preferred first stop for watermark-free modern context footage.

modern_stock_video.name: Pixabay
modern_stock_video.rule: Use only clips with item-level terms compatible with the upload and no brand/personality risk.

modern_stock_video.name: Mixkit
modern_stock_video.rule: Verify the clip is under a free stock-video license, not a restricted license.

modern_stock_video.name: Coverr
modern_stock_video.rule: Log attribution text and item terms; avoid visible brands, trademarks, or sensitive uses.

modern_stock_video.name: Videvo or Videezy
use_for: aerials when no safer source exists
modern_stock_video.rule: Use selectively only after item-level license, attribution, and editorial-use status are logged.

archival_video.name: NASA Image and Video Library
archival_video.rule: Do not imply NASA endorsement; respect logo, person, and promotion restrictions.

archival_video.name: Internet Archive / Prelinger
archival_video.rule: Use only when item metadata supports public-domain or compatible reuse.

disallowed_sources: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or X reposts without explicit rights
editorial-only stock clips for monetized public uploads
assets with unclear creator, source URL, or rights basis
AI-generated images presented as historical photos
stock footage used to imply endorsement, participation, or exact historical evidence
AI-generated city hero image used while rights-safe real city hero imagery exists
AI output derived as a near-duplicate of an unlicensed internet reference
AI-generated support element used as historical/source proof
automation_instruction: Before sourcing or approving Pattern Lab images or video, read this policy, resources/visual-acquisition-routing-policy.json, and resources/open-archive-provider-registry.json. Prefer the matching source class. Openverse and Internet Archive results are candidate-only until original-item verification, local download, and hashing complete. If no safe source exists, use an original Pattern Lab map, source board, timeline, or labeled reconstruction instead. For thumbnails, resolve the active city first; source recognizable city hero media before using AI support assets.
exact_item_receipt_rule: A search URL, provider category page, or API query is not a production source. Preserve the exact item page, exact download URL, creator, license URL, local hash, retrieval time, and editorial role for every selected external asset.
ai_motion_runtime_rule: AI motion is an optional support layer, capped by the visual density requirements. It cannot replace source-pack floors, historical proof, or narration matching.

allowed: generic underground tunnel/sewer/crowd/paper/map texture when not presented as source evidence
partial-redaction document props with fictional text
lighting/atmospheric/background extension layers that cannot be mistaken for archival proof
blocked: generic support image used as if it depicts the active city
AI image presented as archival/source proof
support image identifiable as another specific city but used for the active city

allowed: generic underground/tunnel/sewer support when not city-specific proof
redacted paper/document prop with fictional text
blocked: AI-generated fake city skyline when real city imagery is available
AI support asset without support_not_evidence ledger classification
